question: Why did marketing spend jump in Q3 2024?
expect: Spend was 543,834 in 2024-Q1 and 570,860 in 2024-Q2, then 677,365 in 2024-Q3. The data starts in 2024, so only two earlier quarters exist.
answer: Assuming Q3 2024 is compared to Q2 2024, the jump in marketing spend was primarily driven by Online, which was higher at 235,763.72 compared to 175,376.17 previously. Normally, Online spend ranged between 174,040.63 and 175,376.17 in earlier periods. Meanwhile, Direct was also higher at 237,222.05 compared to 189,109.48, and Partner was about the same at 204,379.43 compared to 206,374.82, so it does not explain the difference. Total marketing spend in Q3 2024 was 677,365.20.
